title: DiscussionMetadata
description: Structured detail of a discussion message. Every field is optional: which fields a message carries depends on its messageType and on who sent it. Readers ignore fields they do not know.

signal.description: The signal an agent sent, the same as messageType. Sent on every agent signal and on the lifecycle signals.

role.description: The sending agent's discussion role, such as tooler or analyst. Sent on agent signals.

modelName.description: The model the sender is configured with. Sent on agent signals and on the coordinator's advisory, advisory_ready and review_ready.

model.description: The model an agent's call ran on, which differs from modelName when a warm model was used; on waiting and on a capacity stand-aside, the model the agent waits for or could not place.

gpuLabel.description: The accelerator the sender ran on, such as a ModelProvider name; none when it ran on none.

provider.description: The ModelProvider that served an agent's call, chosen when the call was made.

pickReason.description: Why the scheduler picked the provider, as text.

evicted.description: Models the scheduler unloaded to make room for the call.

inferenceMs.description: Milliseconds spent in model calls for the message.

inferenceStartMs.description: When the agent's work for the signal started, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; 0 when unknown.

loadDurationMs.description: Milliseconds the model server spent loading the model for the coordinator's advisory call.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens of the model calls behind the message.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens of the model calls behind the message.

totalTokens.description: On an agent signal, inputTokens plus outputTokens. On thread_close, the coordinator's own token counts per step.

toolsUsed.description: The tools the agent has enabled, sent with agree. It lists what the agent could call, not the calls it made.

reason.description: Why: on stand_aside and waiting, gpu-busy, model-too-large or prompt-too-large; on gap_detected, the gap in words; on stop_requested, manual_stop; on a scheduled message, the reason it was scheduled.

predictorReason.description: The scheduler's explanation for a capacity stand-aside.

failureType.description: The kind of failure on a failure signal, such as same_tool_repeated, too_many_tool_failures, iterations_exhausted, loop_time_exceeded, model_timeout, model_oom, provider_unreachable, internal_exception or evaluation_timeout.

failedTool.description: The tool that failed, on a failure signal.

failureCount.description: On a failure signal, how many tool calls failed; on review_ready, how many agents sent failure.

lastError.description: The last error text of a failure, truncated.

exceptionClass.description: The Java exception class behind a failure that was not a tool failure.

synthesizedBy.description: Set to coordinator on a failure the coordinator sent for an agent that missed its deadline.

userQuery.description: The person's question, on thread_start, advisory_ready and review_ready.

primaryChannel.description: The channel the thread is answered on.

conversationId.description: The conversation a thread_start belongs to.

conversationContext.description: Earlier turns of the conversation, oldest first.

crew.description: The crew a thread_start belongs to.

crewVersion.description: The version of the crew chart that produced the thread, when the crew has one.

replayOf.description: The thread a dashboard replay repeats the question of.

technologies.description: The technologies the coordinator's advisory names.

layers.description: The layers of the system the coordinator's advisory names.

wisdom.description: The coordinator's advisory text, on advisory.

advisory.description: The coordinator's advisory text, on advisory_ready: the brief for the convened agents.

innerCircle.description: The agents the coordinator convened. Absent when every agent may take part.

triageConfidence.description: The coordinator's confidence in its choice of the inner circle.

selectedSkills.description: The skills the coordinator selected for the thread.

agents.description: The agents a triage_result selects, each with its confidence and reason.

overallConfidence.description: The coordinator's confidence in a triage_result as a whole.

agreeCount.description: How many agents sent agree, on review_ready.

concernCount.description: How many agents sent concern, on review_ready.

standAsideCount.description: How many agents sent stand_aside, on review_ready.

gapType.description: The gap a gap_detected names: agents that lack tools, no agent with the expertise, or tools that failed.

toolGapConcerns.description: On a TOOL_GAP, each agent's concern, by agent name.

onboarding.description: Set on messages from an onboarding agent.

consentAck.description: Set on an onboarding agent's agree to a proposal.

scheduleId.description: The schedule a scheduled message comes from.

kind.description: The kind of a scheduled message: reminder or followup.

sourceThreadId.description: The thread a scheduled message continues.

originalSourceThreadId.description: The thread a scheduled message would have continued, when it starts a new thread instead.

degraded.description: Set when a scheduled message starts a new thread because it could not continue its source thread.

TokenTotals.title: TokenTotals
TokenTotals.description: The coordinator's token counts by step: advisory, triage and synthesis.

query.description: The question of an earlier turn.

response.description: The answer of an earlier turn, truncated.

confidence.description: The coordinator's confidence in the agent.

reason.description: Why the coordinator selected the agent.
